# SCP-173 Abilities
This page describes the active abilities available to the object and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General information about the Sculpture" link="Scp173About"]
## "Contaminate Tile" Ability
Activating this ability contaminates the tile with a special reagent that opens the blast doors in the containment chamber once enough of it accumulates. Use it to escape the containment chamber.
[textlink="More information about escape methods" link="Scp173ContainmentBreach"]
## "Desecrate" Ability
Activating this ability deals a small amount of damage to every nearby structure and has a chance to open airlocks and blast doors. This ability only works outside the containment chamber.
## "Lunge" Ability
Activating this ability moves you a short distance, killing anyone caught in your path. This ability only works when no more than two people are looking at you, and it cannot be used inside the containment chamber.
## "Blind" Ability
Activating this ability forces everyone nearby to close their eyes for a short time. This ability only works when at least four people are looking at you, and it cannot be used outside the containment chamber.
## Safe Period Mechanic
During the first 15 minutes of the round, you cannot use the "Contaminate Tile" ability.
This mechanic limits SCP objects at the start of the round, giving personnel time to prepare for the shift.
## Neck-Snapping Mechanic
The game features a unique system that lets SCP-173 automatically kill people it collides with. You do not even need to enable combat mode!
## Vision Mechanic
The game features a unique system that checks whether each character is visible to another character.
